experiment: S7 all media vs all workers, same money, single-region electorate

design.metric: expected vote share E (mean vote probability), %; mean over worlds, t-based 95% CI
design.rounds_axis: round 0 = before round 1; round t = after round t

single_region.how: ElectorateConfig(min_region_fraction=0.0, region_dirichlet_a=0.001): Dirichlet split is one-hot, all voters in one region, other three empty; no library change

arms.All media: air the region in rounds 1..3 (₫200.00 each, total ₫600.00)
arms.All workers: 30 workers in round 1 in the region (₫600.00), nothing afterwards
